locator: pp. 427–434, §§5.1–5.3: third factor, survival and limits; especially pp. 430–432 and note 44
interpretation: Qualified realist reply, not a derivation of normativity from reproductive success. The goodness assumption is first-order normative; the belief–action mechanism, starting points and reasoning reliability are further commitments. Note 44 distinguishes explaining correlation/possibly defeating a defeater from directly justifying normative beliefs. No quantitative probability is assigned.
